resume_unit: atomic seed/method/dataset NPZ + SHA-256 completion receipt
rng_policy: One stream seed per MC seed/dataset; 5 sequential passes; never reseed per forward/batch; isolated DataLoader CPU generator
timing_scope: Group inference seconds include checkpoint loading and small audit/repeat probes; exclude dataset loading, metrics, serialization, plotting, SHA-256 tree audit

plot_settings.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of per-seed density histograms, not raw counts
plot_settings.y_axis: Common limits within each ID/OOD row; rows may differ

protected_integrity.algorithm: SHA-256 + byte size + complete file-path set
protected_integrity.includes: All files including .venv, ignored data, outputs and checkpoints
